text:
kai: Quick heads-up — I'm about to land a small TF refactor that moves SA bindings + secret path wiring into the overlays layer (dev/staging/prod). Before I promote to prod, can we confirm the release-gate checklist?

samir: pinged. main concerns: keep secrets paths stable, make sure RBAC bindings don't drop, and add a canary rollout for the deployment. :eyes:

olivia: If you're changing the secret path, add a migration hook. our rotation job still expects /secrets/prod/db-creds. Otherwise rotation will fail after promote.

kai: good call. plan is to keep legacy alias for 30d and set new path via overlay var.secret_base. rough diffs below:

kai: ```hcl
# modules/infra/secrets.tf (old)
resource \"aws_secretsmanager_secret\" \"db\" {
  name = \"${var.env}/db-creds\"
}

# overlays/prod/terraform.tfvars (new)
secret_base = \"/envs/prod\"
```

kai: and k8s overlay patch:```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  labels:
    rollout: canary
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: infra-worker-sa
      containers:
      - name: worker
        env:
        - name: DB_SECRET_PATH
          value: \"/envs/prod/db-creds\"
```

jess: Can you include a short terraform plan snippet and the k8s rollout annotation? Also add a constraint (Gatekeeper) so accidental promote to prod without canary label fails CI.

samir: Agree on gatekeeper. I'll draft a constraint that requires label `rollout` on Deployments in prod. Minimal constraint: `require-label-rollout-prod`.

infra-bot: tf plan (staging) — 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. No IAM deltas.

olivia: For the migration hook, suggest a small lambda that copies alias from old path to new for existing keys, and then update rotation to point at new alias once copied. Keep a flag in the overlay: `migration_enable = true` for 24h.

kai: thanks — I'll: add canary label to overlay deployment, include Gatekeeper constraint + template, add migration lambda + tfvar `migration_enable`, and leave legacy alias for 30d.

jess: can you drop the PR link here when ready and tag @samir @olivia ? i'll do a quick CR. Also add a note in the release gating doc (docs/releases/overlays.md) about the required label and rollout verification steps.

kai: will do. expected PR later today. small checklist for prod promote (to keep in PR body):
- [ ] terraform plan shows only additions (no IAM removal)
- [ ] gatekeeper constraint present in overlays/prod/constraints/
- [ ] deployment has `rollout: canary` and annotation `rollout.k8s.redwood/verify=true`
- [ ] migration lambda + `migration_enable` TF var default off in master, enabled by release job
- [ ] smoke check script run against canary pods (logs + KV cache warmup)

samir: if you want I can run the smoke job once PR merges to staging.

kai: appreciate it. tagging @samir @jess @olivia in PR. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: promote to prod will require manual approval in the release pipeline due to constraint changes.

jess: perfect. small nit — add a one-line note about rollback steps in case migration fails (how to re-point rotation back to legacy alias).

kai: added to checklist. thanks everyone — will post PR link soon.
